resources.string: Saved. You can come back any time.
To switch on your connection, the law requires us to check your business (KYC). Here is what we collect, why, and for how long.
Check the business is registered and active
Confirm who can sign the contract

Documents are deleted 30 days after your KYC is approved. After that we keep only the result and masked numbers (like 27******34X1Z5) for your contract. If KYC is rejected, everything is deleted after 30 days.
Who sees it: only our KYC team and, if needed, the agent handling your order. Photos are read on this phone, stored encrypted, and never used for marketing.
You can withdraw consent any time from Privacy settings (⚙ at the top). Your documents are then deleted.
I agree to KYC verification of these documents (required)
Installation address (only if different from your GST address)
Format is valid, but not found in the registry. You can continue and confirm it later.
The last character doesn\'t match. Please check for a typo.
Scan each document: the camera finds the edges and cleans the page. You can also pick a photo from your gallery. We read it on this phone.
Reading the document on your phone…
Photo is unclear, please retake in good light.
Too small - move closer so the document fills the frame.
Too dark - move to a brighter spot.
This looks like a %1$s, but we need a %2$s.
Fix anything we read wrongly. Fields you change are checked more carefully.
This Aadhaar shows the full number. Please upload a masked Aadhaar (only the last 4 digits visible). We never store a full Aadhaar number.
Please upload all documents to continue.
Demo only: pick a sample applicant\'s document.
Demo documents are not in this build.
Camera permission is needed to take a photo. You can use the gallery instead.
We checked your documents against the GST and Udyam registries.
Your business is verified. Next: e-sign the contract and we\'ll schedule installation.
Go back to the review to fix or confirm them.
Reason: %1$s\n\nTicket %2$s: an agent will call you within 1 working day.
Demo only: a real e-Sign sends an OTP to your Aadhaar-linked mobile. No Aadhaar number is collected here.
See a plan without GST products
No KYC consent on this phone.
Withdraw consent and delete my documents
This deletes all your KYC photos and details from this phone. You\'ll need to do KYC again before we can switch on your connection.
Deleted %1$d files. Your KYC data is gone from this phone.
Too bright or faded - move out of direct light.
Glare on the document - tilt it slightly or turn off the flash.
Blurry - hold the phone still and tap the screen to focus.
Check that all the text is sharp and nothing is cut off.
We\'re not sure we read this right. Please check it against the paper.
We fixed a character the camera misread (%1$s). Please check it against the paper.

Please tick “This is correct” for the highlighted fields, pick the right date, or fix them.
Fit the document inside the frame, in good light
A person from our team will check this. You don\'t need to do anything.
This document can\'t be opened any more (it was deleted or its key was destroyed). Please upload it again.
Use your fingerprint, face or phone PIN to view your saved document.
To view saved documents, first set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or fingerprint) on this phone. Uploading still works without it.
This phone looks rooted or modified, so other apps may be able to reach stored files. You can continue; your documents are still encrypted, but consider using another phone.
The %1$s on your %2$s can be read two ways: %3$s or %4$s. Please tap “Check details” and pick the right one.
We couldn\'t read the %1$s on your %2$s clearly - please rescan it, or tap “Check details” to confirm it.
%1$s: photo is unclear, please retake in good light.
This looks like a %1$s, but we need %2$s.
an address proof (utility bill, bank statement or rent agreement)
This Aadhaar shows the full number. Please upload a masked Aadhaar (only the last 4 digits visible).
Part of your %1$s (%2$s) looks different from the rest of the document. A person from our team will check it; you don\'t need to do anything.

The same photo was uploaded as %1$s and %2$s.
Please enter your GSTIN, or tick “I don\'t have a GSTIN”.

Address proof matches your business address.
